title: Acids and Bases
description: An acid gives up a proton, a base takes one; pH counts the hydrogen ions on a scale of ten-fold steps. Titrate to the endpoint and you know a reagent's strength exactly. Unlocks the Titration Bench and the purity tag.

puzzle.goal: A sample of volume V and concentration C is titrated with a standard of concentration B. Write the volume E of standard needed to reach the endpoint.
puzzle.name: Equivalence volume
puzzle.ask: Find E in mL for C = @{C} mol/L, V = @{V} mL and B = @{B} mol/L.
puzzle.method: At the endpoint the moles of standard equal the moles in the sample: B·E = C·V.
